description: This file is a standalone PHP script designed for silent upgrade operations of a SuiteCRM/DCE instance. It includes utility functions for cache clearing, configuration checks, database relationship creation, and merging password settings. The script verifies command-line execution, processes upgrade parameters, loads necessary modules and configuration, and performs a series of upgrade steps including file copying, database repairs, module and relationship updates, theme cache clearing, language rebuilds, and error handling. It is highly project-specific and contains embedded usage instructions and upgrade logic.
